WITH drug_total_inventory AS (
  SELECT 
    d.drug_id,
    d.generic_name,
    d.brand_name,
    SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) as total_quantity
  FROM drugs d
  JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id
  GROUP BY d.drug_id, d.generic_name, d.brand_name
),
min_inventory AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_quantity) as min_qty FROM drug_total_inventory
)
SELECT 
  dti.generic_name,
  dti.brand_name,
  dti.total_quantity,
  i.batch_number,
  i.quantity_on_hand,
  i.warehouse_location,
  i.production_date,
  i.expiry_date
FROM drug_total_inventory dti
JOIN min_inventory mi ON dti.total_quantity = mi.min_qty
JOIN inventory i ON dti.drug_id = i.drug_id
ORDER BY dti.generic_name, i.warehouse_location
